subject: POC kickoff — coordinating cross-team windows and success criteria (CloudFlag)
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@cloudflag.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudFlag POC kickoff — availability & preliminary success criteria

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for taking this forward. We had a brief internal sync and want to get the POC kickoff on the calendar next week. High level: CloudFlag will evaluate inference latency at our 25k qps baseline, end-to-end data handling (no PII persisted), and simple integration with our ingestion pipeline.

Attendees we expect:
- Alex Jenkins (cloudflag) — product lead
- Engin Ops (procurement) — procurement@cloudflag.com
- Security (sec team) — security@cloudflag.com
- Two backend engineers (TBD)

From Redwood we want: AE to own timelines & commercial items, SE to own technical runbook and environment setup, and security contact for the evidence checklist.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Sep 1 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Sep 2 — 09:00–10:30 or 14:00–15:30

Can you confirm who will attend from Redwood and which slot works? Also attaching a short doc with our initial success criteria (we'll refine during the call).

Thanks,
Alex

[Attachment: CloudFlag-POC-success-criteria.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@cloudflag.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudFlag POC kickoff — availability & preliminary success criteria

Alex —

Appreciate the details. Monica (AE) will lead the kickoff and own the timeline; Karthik (SE) will lead the technical runbook and be joined by one of our infra engineers. I've looped Soojin from security so we can align on the evidence questionnaire.

Quick responses:
- Attendees from Redwood: Monica Patel (AE), Karthik Iyer (SE), Rishi Malhotra (Eng/Sales liaison), Soojin Lee (Security)
- Best slots for our team: Tue Sep 1 15:00–16:30 PT or Wed Sep 2 09:00–10:30 PT. If you expect procurement/security will need extra time, we can do 90 minutes.

Action items for the kickoff (to confirm on call):
1) Finalize PO/contract owner and procurement timeline (Alex/procurement)
2) Define technical success criteria (latency / throughput numbers and test harness)
3) Confirm data handling: what endpoints, whether we need IP allowlists, and KMS expectations
4) Security evidence handoff & timeline (Soojin)

I'll wait for your preferred slot and will put tentative hold on our calendars.

Best,
Rishi

--

Partnerships & Solutions
Redwood Inference

Alex / team —

Quick note from SE side: 90 minutes would be ideal for the kickoff so we can cover environment access, test harness, and a short demo of our latency/kv-cache tuning flows. If you have backend engineers present we can do a 60–75 minute focused session but will keep the 90 minute buffer as a fallback.

Also: please confirm whether the test harness will run inside CloudFlag VPC or if we should bring a controlled sample dataset. That affects what I prepare.

I can be remote for either Tue Sep 1 15:00 PT or Wed Sep 2 09:00 PT — prefer Tue 15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik
